Get Started

Who This Is For

Postgraduate Students
NGOs
Independent Researchers
Academic Institutions

You've spent months collecting data — surveys, lab results, field observations — and now you're staring at a spreadsheet that doesn't mean anything yet. Analyzing it correctly, choosing the right tests, and writing results a supervisor or reviewer won't reject is a different skill from collecting it.

We take your raw data and turn it into clean, correctly‑run statistical output with plain‑language interpretation, so you understand exactly what your results mean and can defend them in a viva or peer review.

What's Included

Descriptive statistics (means, frequencies, cross‑tabs)
Inferential tests — t‑tests, ANOVA, chi‑square, correlation
Regression analysis (linear, logistic, multiple)
Reliability testing (Cronbach's Alpha)
Results write‑up in APA format
One round of clarification/revision included
Tools we use:SPSSSTATARExcelPython

How It Works

01

Share Your Data

Send your raw dataset and research questions/hypotheses in whatever format you have it.

02

We Confirm the Right Tests

We map your questions and variable types to the correct statistical tests before running anything.

03

Analysis & Output

We run the analysis and produce clean tables, figures, and syntax/output files.

04

Interpretation & Handover

You receive a plain‑language write‑up of what each result means, ready to drop into your paper or report.

Why Work With Us

Correct test selection, not just running whatever SPSS defaults to
Interpretation written in plain English, not just raw output
Confidential handling — your data is never shared or reused
Direct access to the analyst, not a call center

Frequently Asked Questions

What file formats can you work with?

Excel, CSV, SPSS (.sav), STATA (.dta), or even paper questionnaires we can help you digitize first.

How long does analysis take?

Most standard datasets are turned around in 24–72 hours depending on complexity and sample size.

Will you explain the results to me?

Yes — every deliverable includes a written interpretation, and we're available for a follow‑up call if needed.

Is my data kept confidential?

Always. We sign NDAs on request and never reuse or share client data.
